title: Spaghetti
description: A classic Italian dish with spaghetti mixed with tomato and herb marinara sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil, cook the spaghetti until al dente, and drain.
Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat and sauté the minced garlic for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for an additional minute.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes, dried basil, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper, stirring well to combine.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and let the marinara sauce simmer for 20 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Toss the cooked spaghetti directly into the marinara sauce until the pasta is evenly coated.
